mapper.select: select rpi.prod_id prod_id, rpi.prod_name prod_name, rpi.prod_re reg_code, listagg(dlr.prod_id, '、') within group(order by dlr.prod_id) saleCode, rpi.raise_type raise_type, max(dlr.trigger_remark) redRemark, max(dlr.reject_remark) refRemark, min(deal_date) redDate from rep_prod_info rpi inner join dis_large_redemption dlr on rpi.prod_re = dlr.prod_regist_no AND dlr.rpt_issue_date = #{rptIssueDate} where rpi.prod_id = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by rpi.prod_id, rpi.prod_name, rpi.prod_re, rpi.raise_type
